The '''Ord Cestus medical station''' was a [[Haven-class medical station|''Haven''-class medical station]] operated by the [[Galactic Republic]] in [[orbit]] around the [[planet]] [[Ord Cestus]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. The station was used to care for their wounded [[clone trooper]]s. In the aftermath of the [[Second Battle of Geonosis]], [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]]s [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee]] were sent to the station to collect medical supplies to be delivered to [[Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu]]'s forces on [[Dantooine]], but their journey was [[Skirmish aboard TB-73|disrupted]] by an infestation of Geonosian [[brain worm]]s onboard their [[starship]], who infected the clones of [[Tango Company]]. At the time, the station was under the command of [[Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto]].<ref name="Brain Invaders" />
